offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures deposition, etch, cleaning and metrology equipment used to make semiconductor, LED and power devices. Sells mainly to chip and device manufacturers, delivering systems and then supporting them through field service and spare parts.

primary_products.value: MOCVD deposition systems; ion beam etch and deposition systems; wafer cleaning systems; atomic layer deposition tools; metrology and inspection tools

primary_services.value: equipment field service; process support; spare parts and upgrades

customer_segment.value: B2B: semiconductor, LED and power device manufacturers, and research institutions

end_markets.value: semiconductors; LEDs and displays; power electronics; wireless communications

revenue_model.value: product sales: capital equipment systems sold to chip and device manufacturers; service fees: field service, spare parts and equipment upgrades

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds deposition, etch and metrology systems from purchased components, sold to chip manufacturers; service provider: maintains installed systems and sells process support to fab customers

geography_served.value: global: Sells to customers in Asia, Europe and North America, with manufacturing and service in the US

specialization.value: related lines: deposition, etch, cleaning and metrology tools sold to the same semiconductor customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct sales teams selling to major chip and device manufacturers; partners / resellers: local agents and representatives in some regions

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: export controls on semiconductor equipment, plus environmental and workplace safety rules for hazardous process gases

notes: A pending merger with Axcelis Technologies may change the business; this describes the current standalone company.
